qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive franchise territory monopoly in southeast Michigan. High physical and legal barriers prevent grid duplication. Fuel and energy cost pass-through riders protect margins, though regulated allowed ROEs (9.9%) cap ROIC at ~6.2%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Regulated electric and gas monopoly in southeast Michigan with solid operational execution following the 2021 DT Midstream spin-off. However, severe debt burden ($25.3B long-term debt, 17.3x net income, 2.25x interest coverage) and multi-billion annual capex ($4.3B+) require continuous debt issuance and reliance on capital markets, while ROIC is capped at ~6.2%.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC of 6.2%. FY2025 long-term debt of $25,306M dwarfs net income of $1,462M (17.3x ratio). EBIT of $2,374M against interest expense of $1,056M yields 2.25x interest coverage, failing the > 5.0x requirement. Company regularly issues junior subordinated debentures to defend credit metrics while funding capital expansion.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
